title.zh: 苹果官宣：Apple智能接入阿里千问，11月4日开放测试
title.en: 苹果官宣：Apple智能接入阿里千问，11月4日开放测试

current_state.zh: Apple and Alibaba announced that Qwen will be integrated into Apple Intelligence in China, powering Siri, writing tools and visual intelligence, with developer beta testing starting November 4 ahead of a December iOS 27.3 rollout.
current_state.en: Apple and Alibaba announced that Qwen will be integrated into Apple Intelligence in China, powering Siri, writing tools and visual intelligence, with developer beta testing starting November 4 ahead of a December iOS 27.3 rollout.
